name: exit_lean_wall
text: A person rests their lower back against the wall with both arms down and knees gently bent. Immediately push through the feet and begin to straighten and step forward away from the wall. Rise directly without first dipping the hips or squatting lower. Keep the chest and head gently forward until the hips have moved clear, then finish straightening to relaxed upright standing with both arms down. One smooth short step away from the wall; no dipping, bouncing, sitting, falling or reaching.

Push gently through the planted feet, take one short step forward away from the wall, then straighten the knees and chest and return to relaxed upright standing. Keep both arms down and the head away from the wall throughout. Finish upright and still, fully separated from the wall. No reaching, sitting or falling.
